data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open Attractions & Tickets, enter city, enter keyword, search, sort, open top result) with the right parameters, but it makes the final action a vague optional "look at details (e.g. Nearby)" instead of a named {action} parameter (view nearby or add to favorites), and it treats the result as a named parameter instead of the top result. A browser automation could still be built from it.
